newsitem.title: CHINA: Foreign investment falls in coastal China province.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investment falls in coastal China province.

text.p: Foreign investment in China's coastal provinces fell sharply in the first three months of this year with 11 provinces reporting a drop of more than 50 percent, the Shanghai-based Business News said on Thursday.

The worst-hit were Hebei and Shandong provinces with a fall of 91 percent, followed by Zhejiang with a drop of 89 percent, the newspaper said. SHANGHAI, May 29 (Reuter) - Foreign investment in China's coastal provinces fell sharply in the first three months of this year with 11 provinces reporting a drop of more than 50 percent, the Shanghai-based Business News said on Thursday.
The worst-hit were Hebei and Shandong provinces with a fall of 91 percent, followed by Zhejiang with a drop of 89 percent, the newspaper said.
